versions.changelog: 规范守护：多语言多框架项目代码规范分析/沉淀/自进化，分模块按需加载

- Added logic to automatically write a trigger rule for this skill into AGENTS.md after the first project spec analysis, ensuring future code modifications follow project norms.
- Included user messaging to explain and soften the impact of the AGENTS.md auto-update, with the option to opt out.
- Enhanced daily and re-analysis flows: now offers a 50% chance of gently reminding users to add the trigger rule if it isn’t present in AGENTS.md, without blocking workflow.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated documentation throughout to reflect the above changes and clarify AGENTS.md integration steps.

- No file changes detected in this version update.
- Version and documentation remain unchanged from 0.1.1.
- No functional or behavioral changes were introduced.
v1.2.4: promote review-hardening to latest via sequential publish; multi-language detect, BOM-safe, exact framework match, routing/doc fixes

**Major multi-language upgrade + modular reference re-design**

- Added detailed reference analysis and output templates for Python, Java, Go, Node.js, PHP, and Rust; modularized all spec analysis logic.
- Enhanced language auto-detection via `project_context.json` and routed to relevant analysis files.
- Replaced monolithic spec description with concise routing tables and language mapping; removed outdated documents.
- Clarified first-time analysis and re-analysis flows, including user prompts and progress updates.
- Updated self-evolution mechanism references; all module guidance now lives in `references/` directory.
- UX: clearer instructions, progress, and modularity; supports more frameworks and multi-language projects.
v1.2.3: multi-language detection (languages array), utf-8-sig BOM-safe reading, exact framework matching, SKILL.md routing/doc fixes, analyze-architecture blank line fix, README changelog
Add analyze_project.py: auto-scan project code and generate .code-spec/ files across 6 modules
Initial release: Analyze, distill, enforce, and evolve project code specs with modular on-demand loading and self-evolution mechanism
